items.prompt: Lower contains original values 2 and 9. With negation plus heapq, which stored root exposes its maximum?

options.why: The most negative stored key corresponds to the largest original value.
A min-heap of negated values chooses -9 before -2.
The lower heap stores negated rather than original values.

options.text: The last stored value, regardless of order.
options.why: A heap guarantees its extremum at the root, not the final array position.
